description: Get the full bilingual AI analysis for one r/wallstreetbets DD post. Returns: AI-generated title, post summary (author's thesis + evidence + holes), discussion summary (top-rated rebuttals, OP responses, irony detection), affected tickers with sentiment, and a fact-check list — each fact-check item has a status (supported / questionable / unsupported / unclear) and source URLs when available. The original Reddit selftext is also included for context. Discover postId via get_dd_list or search_dd.

postId.description: Reddit post id, e.g. '1tbev9x'. Get from get_dd_list or search_dd.

name: get_dd_post
